title: Interpretation 13-04 (Snohomish County Fire District 1): fire classification of rooftop photovoltaic systems relative to the roof assembly (IBC 1509.7.2)
jurisdiction: Washington State, requested by Snohomish County Fire District 1 (comparative test only; not Alberta)
code_edition: 2012 International Building Code, Section 1509.7 and 1505, as cited

facts.text: Document type: State Building Code Council interpretation no. 13-04, one page; requester Snohomish County Fire District 1.
Section 1509.7.2 requires rooftop-mounted photovoltaic systems to have the same fire classification as the roof assembly required by Section 1505.
The question raises that a solar panel's fire classification could exceed that of the roof it is installed on.
